$description: How AnixOps Net maps AnixOps Design onto its own token names. Every value is a reference into the vendored AnixOps Design tokens (upstream below); nothing here is a literal colour. .github/scripts/design_tokens.py resolves the references and generates apps/ios/Sources/NetworkCoreAppHost/BrandTokens.swift (iOS, iPadOS, macOS, widget) and apps/windows-gui/ui/src/design/tokens.css (aliases over the vendored tokens.css for Windows and Linux); CI fails when the generated files are stale. Never edit the generated files by hand. To change a colour, change AnixOps Design and sync it (.github/scripts/sync_design.py).
$brand: Colours that are the same in every theme. Brand moments only (the mark, the connect hero, widgets and the Live Activity on slate); never controls or body text. References are color.brand.* or color.dark.* paths in the upstream file.
$palette: Per-theme colours. A string names the same token in color.light and color.dark; an object names one per theme. bg is the screen behind grouped cards: the grouped background in light, pure black in dark, as in AnixOps Design.
$desktop: Desktop CSS variable names the stylesheet uses, as aliases of AnixOps Design variables (the vendored tokens.css defines them for both themes).
$typography: One scale for every platform. ios = the Dynamic Type style it scales with; desktop = the AnixOps Design type step; weight = regular | medium | semibold | bold (AnixOps Design: titles 600–700, body 400, caption 500).
$radius: AnixOps Design radius steps: sm for buttons and inputs, md for cards, lg for large cards and sheets, pill for chips, segmented controls and pill buttons.
$motion: AnixOps Design durations; connectDraw (the route line drawing in) and the spring are product-specific.
